children: The Trust’s NAV per Share rose 3.20% in the third quarter, slightly less than silver’s 3.28% price increase, as the Sponsor’s Fee reduced returns. Share creations increased outstanding shares, while redemptions partially offset that growth.
: Silver rose 3.28%, from $58.80 per ounce at June 30 to $60.73 at September 30.
: 4.3 million Shares were created and 1.15 million were redeemed during the quarter.
: NAV increased 7.81% to $4.26B as of September 30, 2026.
: The net Sponsor’s Fee was $3.3M, or 0.30% of average net asset value on an annualized basis.
